breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the lumped-capacitance method is invalid for a Biot number of 5. It resolved this by changing the Biot number to a valid value of 0.05, explicitly stating that this confirms the validity of the method (Bi < 0.1). This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
